verdict: Organic visibility is shrinking with no paid channel active right now.
narrative: In the last 28 days, no paid ads ran on any channel, so your Google Business Profile was the only source of inbound activity. That GBP activity totaled 49 actions — but it dropped 44% in the most recent 7 days compared to the 7 days before, and the last 3 days recorded zero actions at all, confirming the decline is real and not a blip. Search clicks also fell sharply over the same stretch, pointing to thinning local search visibility with nothing paid behind it to compensate. Website sessions are actually up week-over-week, though zero conversions were recorded this period — conversion tracking is being reviewed to confirm it is capturing accurately. Restoring a paid channel is the immediate priority so inbound activity is no longer dependent on organic alone.

watch_item.issue: GBP actions hit zero for the last 3 days of the period, with search clicks also near zero — organic reach is at its lowest point of the window.
watch_item.fix: Reactivating paid advertising is in motion to restore a reliable inbound channel and reduce dependence on organic visibility alone.
